strings.Sushi 需要 x64 sushi.exe 及同目录的 x64 sndfile: Sushi requires x64 sushi.exe and x64 sndfile.dll in the same folder. Check your rendering components.
strings.Sushi 需要 x64 Windows VST2 插件，不能加载 x86 或其: Sushi requires an x64 Windows VST2 plugin and cannot load x86 or other architectures.
strings.Sushi 原生适配器目前仅开放 Windows x64。: Native Sushi adapter is currently available only on Windows x64.

strings.Vital 未产生 WAV；该安装版本可能不支持原生渲染。: Vital produced no WAV. This installed version may not support native rendering.
strings.Vital 音色包超过安全读取大小限制。: Vital bank exceeds safe read size limits.
strings.Vital 音色包含不安全的内部路径。: Vital preset contains an unsafe internal path.

strings.Vital 音色包中的预设超过安全读取大小限制。: Preset inside Vital bank exceeds safe read size limits.
strings.Vital 预设超过安全读取大小限制。: Vital preset exceeds safe read size limits.
strings.Vital 预制超过 64 MB 读取限制。: Vital preset exceeds the 64 MB read limit.
strings.Vital 预制缺少有效 settings 对象，禁止把初始音色误记为此预制。: Vital preset lacks a valid settings object. Refusing to misidentify an initial preset as this preset.
strings.Vital 原生 --length 按整数秒读取，请使用 1 到 30 秒的整数: Vital native --length uses whole seconds. Use an integer hold duration from 1 to 30 seconds.
strings.Vital 原生方式只能用于 Vital。: Vital native method is only for Vital.
strings.Vital 原生力度固定为 0.7（约 MIDI 89），尾音固定为按键时长的: Vital native velocity is fixed at 0.7 (about MIDI 89), with a tail of 30% of hold duration. Use Vital native settings.
strings.Vital 原生命令行尚不支持安全地生成无预制的默认启动基准；未使用自造 Ini: Vital native CLI cannot safely generate a startup baseline without a preset. No synthetic Init preset was substituted.
strings.Vital 原生适配器仅能处理 Vital 预制。: Vital native adapter handles only Vital presets.
strings.Vital 原生渲染后端只能处理 Vital，不能用来加载其他音源。: Vital native backend handles only Vital and cannot load other synths.
strings.Vital 原生渲染要求整数秒按键时长、力度 89、尾音为按键时长的 30%；请: Vital native rendering requires integer hold seconds, velocity 89, and a 30% tail. Use Vital native settings.
